Supporters and members of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM) have begun arriving at the Abubakar Tafawa Balewa Stadium, Bauchi, ahead of the party’s presidential campaign flag-off featuring its presidential candidate, Engr. Seyi Makinde.
As of 12:12 p.m., attendees were still arriving at the venue ahead of the arrival of key party leaders, including Makinde, his running mate, Lawal Daura, and the host governor of Bauchi State, Senator Bala Mohammed, alongside other party leaders and stakeholders.
The campaign rally is expected to feature the party’s presidential campaign activities and the presentation of its political agenda ahead of the 2027 general elections.
Recall that Makinde unveiled his manifesto earlier this weekend in Abuja, declaring that Nigeria needs a new political and economic order that focuses on citizen’s welfare.
